project: ComplyStack Console - Zurich Insurance (India) Back-Office Ops

typography.heading_font: Space Grotesk, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif

layout_architecture.header_bar: Fixed top bar h-16 bg-[#0A1F44] text-white flex items-center justify-between px-6 z-50 shadow-md
layout_architecture.persona_switcher: Pill switcher with explicit active states (Underwriter / Distributor Admin / Field Agent) with high-contrast text and subtle ring glow
layout_architecture.navigation_tabs: Secondary sticky nav bar bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-2 flex gap-4 text-sm font-medium
layout_architecture.main_container: max-w-[1600px] mx-auto p-6 space-y-6 bg-[#F8FAFC] min-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)]
layout_architecture.card_style: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5 transition-all hover:border-slate-300
layout_architecture.dense_table: w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse divide-y divide-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm rounded-lg overflow-hidden

insurer_overview.kpi_grid: 4-column metric grid showing Total Pipeline, Avg Risk Score, SLA Breaches, Premium Volume
insurer_overview.funnel_and_tables: Recharts visual conversion funnel alongside distributor league table

case_queue.filters: Search by SME/Lead ID, Risk Band, Distributor, SLA status, Industry filters
case_queue.actions: Quick view, reassign agent, open pre-inspection report

pre_inspection_report.risk_gauge: Custom circular/radial gauge showing 0-100 composite risk with 6 sub-scores
pre_inspection_report.annotated_evidence_gallery: Image canvas with bounding-box hotspots over machine serial plates + OCR extracted fields
pre_inspection_report.video_walkthrough_timeline: Timestamped video keyframe scrubber with identified hazards
pre_inspection_report.machinery_register: Table detailing equipment, age, maintenance record, replacement cost
pre_inspection_report.coverage_gap_analysis: Side-by-side table comparing prior coverage vs recommended Zurich product suite
pre_inspection_report.underwriter_actions: Agent justification form, Insurer approval/request-revision workflow, mis-selling flagging

cyber_website_check.domain_input: URL scanner supporting Southeast Asian SMEs (Malaysia/Indonesia)
cyber_website_check.findings: Security header checks, SSL/TLS grade, SPF/DMARC records with raw proof excerpts

universal_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, persona buttons, tables, filters, forms, and report actions MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='persona-switcher-underwriter', data-testid='case-filter-status').
universal_guidelines.no_transparent_overlays: Dropdowns, dialogs, and sticky headers MUST use solid or high-opacity backdrop blurs to avoid text overlap bleed.
universal_guidelines.js_component_format: Use React standard JSX components (.jsx / .js files). All Shadcn components in src/components/ui should be customized with Tailwind classes.
